notes.title: The release date is being shifted.
notes.notes:
I have to inform you that unfortunately the game will not be able to be released in November.
 The main reason is that I did not have time to finish the game, but there are other factors (I will not cover them). 
The release date is shifted by about 1 year (~ **.09.2025).
I am very sorry.

notes.title: Graphics update.
notes.notes:
With the advent of more powerful game-building equipment, I reworked EVERYTHING!
I replaced all the graphics, from the word - completely.🙊
The previous screenshots and videos have gone into history.

notes.title: Release Demo!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
Yesterday in Steam, a demo version of the game became available.
It is difficult to call it a full-fledged demo version, because. the location is not fully built up, and the ducks are still without intelligence, but for trying on your computer, it will do. To be honest, the demo was released to participate in the February festival - "Games to be" (21.02 - 28.02).
